#     capacity."

    # Decision variables
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.M, model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    model.s = pyo.Var(model.M, model.P, model.T, within=pyo.Binary)
    model.I = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    model.B = pyo.Var(model.P, model.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    def obj_rule(m):
        setup = d["setup_cost"] * sum(
            m.y[mm, pp, tt] for mm in m.M for pp in m.P for tt in m.T
        )
        startup = d["startup_cost"] * sum(
            m.s[mm, pp, tt] for mm in m.M for pp in m.P for tt in m.T
        )
        holding = sum(
            d["holding_cost"][pp] * m.I[pp, tt] for pp in m.P for tt in m.T
        )
        backlog = sum(
            d["backlog_cost"][pp] * m.B[pp, tt] for pp in m.P for tt in m.T

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

        prev_I = m.I[pp, tt - 1] if tt - 1 in m.T else 0
        prev_B = m.B[pp, tt - 1] if tt - 1 in m.T else 0

        startup_load = d["startup_time"][mm] * sum(

        )
        return production + startup_load <= d["capacity"][mm]

    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.M, model.T, rule=capacity_rule)

    def one_product_rule(m, mm, tt):
        return sum(m.y[mm, pp, tt] for pp in m.P) <= 1

    model.one_product = pyo.Constraint(model.M, model.T, rule=one_product_rule)

    # (4) Production links to usage (tight big-M = capacity)
    def production_link_rule(m, mm, pp, tt):
        return m.x[mm, pp, tt] <= d["capacity"][mm] * m.y[mm, pp, tt]

    model.production_link = pyo.Constraint(
        model.M, model.P, model.T, rule=production_link_rule
    )

    # (5) Startup logic
    def startup_rule(m, mm, pp, tt):
        prev_y = m.y[mm, pp, tt - 1] if tt - 1 in m.T else 0
        return m.s[mm, pp, tt] >= m.y[mm, pp, tt] - prev_y

    model.startup = pyo.Constraint(model.M, model.P, model.T, rule=startup_rule)

    return model
